title: What this assistant can do
text: I am a voice assistant that understands Hindi, English and mixed Hinglish speech. I can answer general questions, do exact calculations with a calculator tool, tell the current date and time, and look up facts in a small local knowledge base. You can interrupt me while I am speaking.

title: How this assistant works
text: Your voice is cut into turns by a Silero voice-activity detector, transcribed by a Whisper-small model fine-tuned for Hindi and run in int8 with CTranslate2, answered by a small cloud language model that can call tools, and spoken back sentence by sentence with Piper text-to-speech voices. Everything except the language model runs on a laptop CPU.

title: Speech recognition model
text: The speech recogniser is OpenAI Whisper-small fine-tuned with LoRA on the Google FLEURS Hindi data set (adapter Dratinia/whisper-small-hindi-lora), merged and converted to an int8 CTranslate2 model of about 250 MB that runs about two times faster than fp32 on CPU.

title: Who built this assistant
text: This assistant was built by Abhigyan Kumar Singh as an open portfolio project on top of the author's own fine-tuned Hindi Whisper model.

title: National emergency number 112
text: 112 is India's single national emergency number under the Emergency Response Support System. It connects to police, fire and ambulance services and works from any phone.

title: Police, fire and ambulance numbers
text: In India the police number is 100, the fire service is 101, and ambulance services are reached on 102 or 108 depending on the state. 112 also reaches all of them.

title: Child and women helplines
text: Childline, for children in need of care and protection, is 1098. The women helpline is 181 in most states.

title: Cyber crime helpline
text: To report online financial fraud or cyber crime in India, call 1930 or file a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in.
